query:
SELECT equipamentoTag, classificacao, SUM(custo) as total, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM item_despesa_importado
WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 4 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1)
AND equipamentoTag IN ('BRITADOR MOVEL METSO', 'BRITADOR MOVEL', 'DRAGA D´ÁGUA A DIESEL', 'HP 200 ( METSO)', 'PÁ CARREG. 966 03', 'PÁ CARREG. 966R04', 'QMK3A00 (RRF 4H99)', 'TC01 (OM100 RM)', 'TC05 (B.MOVEL)')
GROUP BY equipamentoTag, classificacao
ORDER BY equipamentoTag, total DESC;
